meta.name: dep-vref1-r1 — walk champion (hardware contract)
meta.notes: Walk champion of the deployment-contract line: trained on the exact robot interface — no real velocity feedback (meas:=ref), 25-deg tilt envelope, 0.05-0.06 m/s band. Hardware 08-10: walks, but twice built a runaway sideways lean ending in a tip (pinned-leg positive feedback). Implication: fine for short A/B runs, but expect a possible roll ramp — hit X the moment it leans past ~15 deg.
